releases.note: A worker delegated Notification Requests also owns the work their answers unblock: report it as waiting, never done, until that work is done. Name that work with `ask --resumes`. After a guidance change or compaction, load the skill again and run `notifai guidance`.
If `notifai guidance` reports that guidance changed while it printed, run it again before your next Notification Request.
An answer returns to its asking Agent Session. Do the work it unblocks there before reporting: a report sent in place of that work may never be read.
A delegated worker keeps its assignment until it does the work its answer unblocks, before reporting. Describe that work in `ask --resumes`; reporting the answer is not that work.
